Wear your voyage. The summer starts at sunset. Fasten the clasp. Let the tide rise. Follow the pearl. Where you sail next is up to you.

children.text:
Where you sail
next is up to you

The Tides Collection
is an ode to summer

Inspired by the slow glow
of the golden hour

Every voyage begins with a little daring. Trapnest Voyage is crafted for the dreamers and the drifters alike. The Tides Collection blends sun-warmed citrus and a breath of sea salt to loosen your shoulders and stretch your summer evenings.
